mintAuthority.headline: Collateral managers and the PSM mint USDV, while a three-of-four Safe can upgrade the token or add minters with no timelock.
mintAuthority.summary: USDV minting is gated by MINTER_ROLE on DelphoConfigProvider (0x5dbe9bd6), currently held by the Stablecoin DelphoStableManager (0x41346cfc), the HYPE/kHYPE DelphoStableManager (0xf296cc9c), and the USDC/USDT0 DelphoPSM (0x4f5cdd08). However, the USDV token (0x8c6eb3c8) and core protocol contracts are UUPS proxies upgradeable without a timelock by the V1 admin Safe (0x590fec6d, Gnosis Safe 1.4.1, 3-of-4, zero modules, zero guard), which holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on both market ConfigProviders and can grant MINTER_ROLE, pause mint/burn, or adjust collateral caps at any time.

controls.label: Delpho V1 admin multisig (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UUPS upgrade authority)
controls.capDescription: Holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on both DelphoConfigProvider contracts with no timelock; can grant MINTER_ROLE to any address, raise per-collateral supply caps, pause minting/burning, and authorize immediate UUPS upgrades on USDV and all core contracts.

controls.evidence: At HyperEVM block 52378877 (hash 0x9bfd91c517e943b708ce7fa6f13e6ea21a076f8f0e3e22c574fa2b4c64e59c4a), isAdmin(0x590fec6d69508da8498f10d3401ffc0b538fae09) and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x590fec6d...) returned true on both Stablecoin ConfigProvider (0x5dbe9bd6...) and HYPE/kHYPE ConfigProvider (0x5663bc41...). Deployer EOA 0xd2d66763... granted DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to this Safe at blocks 47201301 and 47193116 and revoked its own role at blocks 47203316 and 47193118. The Safe uses SafeL2 1.4.1 singleton 0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762 with threshold 3 over 4 owners, empty getModulesPaginated(0x1, 100), zero guard slot, and zero fallback-handler slot. Signer independence and key custody are not publicly established.

controls.label: Delpho Stablecoin Market StableManager
controls.capDescription: Mints USDV against USDC and USDT0 collateral deposited into the Stablecoin Vault up to 95% LTV and per-collateral supply caps (10,000,000 USDC and 10,000,000 USDT0); caps are adjustable without delay by the V1 admin Safe.
controls.evidence: Verified isMinter(0x41346cfc861ac683c6f575ff041a9a5aa36b4b9b) = true on DelphoConfigProvider 0x5dbe9bd6...; UUPS implementation 0xaad3d267c0cfde31885c774f623a6ae43108e7e7.

controls.label: Delpho HYPE/kHYPE Market StableManager
controls.capDescription: Mints USDV against HYPE and kHYPE collateral deposited into the HYPE/kHYPE Vault up to 65% LTV and per-collateral supply caps (14,119 HYPE and 13,721 kHYPE); caps are adjustable without delay by the V1 admin Safe.
controls.evidence: Verified isMinter(0xf296cc9c08a92e86b1c3a04b10ccf711d996ea50) = true on DelphoConfigProvider 0x5dbe9bd6...; UUPS implementation 0x72bb05a630cc51f1b00297353c0bbf7658749004.

controls.label: Delpho Peg Stability Module (DelphoPSM)
controls.capDescription: Mints USDV 1:1 against deposited USDC (or USDT0 if enabled) subject to PSM mint caps and fresh Chainlink price checks; caps and parameters are controlled by the V1 admin Safe.
controls.evidence: Verified isMinter(0x4f5cdd08efdcf0e9a09e0ed10849f1102b17882d) = true on DelphoConfigProvider 0x5dbe9bd6... (granted at block 47201272); UUPS implementation 0x784496f6fca6722e7de1fe71f9b7040f8edde8fc.

review.evidence: Pinned HyperEVM reads at blocks 52378604 and 52378877 (2026-11-27) confirmed DelphoStable (0x8c6eb3c8d1fddc752684274fb4a3eb98dbe9cd26) is an EIP-1967 UUPS proxy pointing to verified implementation 0xb4616e1814c74f9528aadddc23d45780fa453ccb, bound to DelphoConfigProvider 0x5dbe9bd675e5bf180064c6a751d1ddb2d4ab4e43. Minting and burning require MINTER_ROLE, currently held by the two market StableManagers (0x41346cfc... and 0xf296cc9c...) and DelphoPSM (0x4f5cdd08...). All UUPS upgrades, pause calls, cap adjustments, and role grants are controlled without a timelock by the 3-of-4 V1 admin Safe (0x590fec6d69508da8498f10d3401ffc0b538fae09, SafeL2 1.4.1, zero modules, zero guard). The separate Treasury Safe (0x277cd2bfa7a865859d34ee44e0abaac72168b1c3) shares the same 4 signer addresses and 3-of-4 threshold but holds no admin role on either ConfigProvider. Because the V1 admin Safe can upgrade USDV or authorize arbitrary minters without delay, the economic cap is unbounded and authorityPosture is unbounded-adverse. Smart contracts were audited twice by Sherlock (July 2, 2026 and September 29, 2026).
